faqs.question: Can I see Ropulse before choosing a setup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Explore real app screens in the product tour, or book a demo to discuss your service, branches and devices.

faqs.question: Does Ropulse support restaurant and retail workflows?
faqs.answer: Ropulse includes Register and Backoffice workflows for restaurants, cafés and retail. The available screens and actions depend on your business configuration and installed release.

faqs.question: How do I set up receipt and kitchen printers?
faqs.answer: The illustrated printer guide covers installation, connections, receipts, KOT routing and device bindings. Test your actual printers and ticket destinations before service.

faqs.question: How do I get help?
faqs.answer: Email support@ropulse.io. Our support hours are 10 AM–10 PM Pakistan time (UTC+5). Include your branch, device, app version and the task you need help with.
